The source gives no new concrete E or L construction rule beyond their existing obligation to use the Hero V's architectural language.
Restoring the Hero V does not alter the established rule that the second V sits above E and L but below the Hero V and accent.
The instruction to restore and preserve the Hero V geometry does not change the wordmark's kerning or rhythm goals.
The geometry correction neither resumes nor changes the deferred champagne material treatment.
